description: Store the athlete's own effort rating (1 to 10) and optional feel note in a workout file. Call only with a number the athlete said; an existing Apple rating is refused unless override is true.

effort.description: The effort rating the athlete stated, 1 to 10

feel.description: Optional free-text note from the athlete

id.description: Workout id: the full HealthKit UUID, its first 8 characters, or the file name

override.description: Replace an existing Apple rating when the athlete asks to change it (default false)

name: rate_workout
